caveats: Shared Docker Desktop host; background containers remained active.
Short warm-cache runs, single replicas, fixed modest arrival rate; no maximum capacity or production SLO claim.
p95/p99 per run; medians of three run percentiles are not pooled percentiles. Only 30–31 writes and eight contention requests per run.
JFR samples are statistical and allocation weights are estimates; profile overhead enabled identically for both measured variants.

localRegressionBudget.scope: Local regression budget for the documented 2 availability requests/s, 60,400-booking fixture and fixed container limits
localRegressionBudget.basis: Selected after measuring the baseline; verified against all three optimized runs. Applies to this benchmark, not a production SLO or arbitrary CI hardware.
